slot_fork_from_launch_log: cross-slot prefix fork enabled: mode = checkpoint, min tokens = 1024, cache_idle_slots = 0
equivalence_basis: First-token top-k probabilities from /completion `n_probs` (completion_probabilities, post_sampling_probs false = softmax over the full vocabulary before sampling). The server cannot return full logits, so `logit_maxabs` is max |p_a - p_b| over the UNION of the two top-k sets (an id absent from one side counts as 0 there: an upper bound) and `kld` is KL(a||b) over the top-k union plus one tail bucket, absent ids imputed from that side's tail mass capped at its k-th prob (a coarse-grained KL: a lower bound on the full-vocab KL when the imputation is exact). Greedy-prefix length compares returned token ids over n_predict tokens (ignore_eos). `identical` = all token ids AND every per-position top-k entry equal.
unique_cells_method: max llamacpp:kv_cells_used sampled once after each request (a lower bound of the true peak; item 7 polls at 1 Hz instead)

predeclared_rule: KPF-18.0d item 3 group 3 localisation (the reproducible fork-vs-no-fork divergence at token 161, A/A identical 3/3). On the one load, for the localisation group: the item-3 scenario (source on slot 0 decodes, a child is released at --trigger-tokens source tokens) in three arms, fork / nofork / nofork_repeat (= the A/A), each with the same fresh batch order. Recorded raw: for the SOURCE and the CHILD of every arm the per-token chosen logprob and top-5 (id, logprob) with the top-2 margin for every position in [LO, HI), the slots snapshot at release (per slot: n_prompt_tokens, checkpoint positions with pinned flags, kv_cells), the child's n_fork_tokens / fork_src_slot / fork_src_kind. First divergence position d for fork-vs-nofork, nofork-vs-repeat and fork-vs-repeat of the source streams, and the top-2 margin at d in each arm. aa_noise = max |chosen-token logprob difference| nofork vs repeat over the positions before their first divergence. Classification (counts of each, no pass word): no_fork_divergence (d absent); near_tie_sensitive_position (the no-fork arms also flip at the same d); aa_diverges_earlier (the A/A flips before d: undetermined); fork_effect_candidate (only fork flips at d and the nofork arm's top-2 margin at d is ABOVE aa_noise); within_aa_noise (only fork flips at d and that margin is at or below aa_noise). Only fork_effect_candidate keeps KPF-18 item 3 open.

controls.manifest: prompt_set_sha256 + binary_sha256 + argv (read back from /proc and the launch log) are in this record; per-sibling raw cells (n_fork_tokens from timings and from /slots, prediction, checkpoint sets, errors) are under `cells`
controls.baseline: the fork-off arm (--slot-fork-min-tokens 0) of the same command on the same binary, and champion tip e33229348 (item 6 / KPF-18.0b)
controls.held_out: lengths or prompts used to SET a rule are never used to judge it (arm D holdout cell; arm C/D positions come from the server's own checkpoint offsets, not from fitted numbers)
controls.counted: every sibling is a cell, including errors, aborts and abstentions
controls.reported_as: counts under rule_result; no pass word
